name: FabCon Europe 2026 debrief
summary: This site reports what one attendee learned at FabCon Europe 2026 about applied AI, security and governance in Microsoft Fabric.
Each statement has an evidence label: Slide, Notes, Microsoft, Third party, Research or Our reading.
Speaker statements are not tested facts, and nothing here was tested in the attendee's own tenant.

groups.title: Limits
groups.gloss: What the agent can reach and do

threadMapText: An agent needs three things: context (what it knows), limits (what it can reach and do) and proof (what it leaves behind). A reality check on cost and dependency applies to all three.

pages.title: FabCon Europe 2026 debrief
pages.message: An agent needs context, limits and proof.

pages.title: Context
pages.message: An agent can use only the context that you give it.

pages.title: Identity
pages.message: Each route to the data uses a different identity.

pages.title: Access
pages.message: Access is a path, not a permission.

pages.title: Untrusted input
pages.message: The model cannot separate instructions from data.

pages.title: Evidence
pages.message: A correct answer is not proof.

pages.title: Governance in the loop
pages.message: Governance moves into the development loop.

pages.title: Production reality
pages.message: The prototype is 10% of the work.

pages.title: Where Fabric goes next
pages.message: Fabric becomes the place where agents get context.
